Biometric keys need Android 11 or newer, and a fingerprint or another strong biometric set up on this phone.

The key is made in the secure hardware of this phone and can never be copied out of it. Every time ssh signs in with it, TermiNow asks for your fingerprint. If fingerprints are added or removed, the key stops working. Copy its public key to your servers like any other key.
%1$s was made. Copy its public key to your servers.

resources.string: Like ssh-keygen -t ecdsa-sk: the key is made on your FIDO2 security key and never leaves it. Plug it in over USB or hold it to the back of the phone for NFC, and touch or tap it every time ssh signs in. Servers need OpenSSH 8.2 or newer.
Plug in your security key, or hold it to the back of the phone, then touch it when it blinks.
ssh asks to sign in with %1$s. Plug in your security key or hold it to the back of the phone, then touch it.
That did not work (%1$s). Try again.
No security key was found in time
